name: PastaMania - Tampines Mall
description:
From Italian classics like Prawn Aglio and Carbonara, to specially crafted fusion delights like Seafood Tom Yum and Salted Egg Chicken, there’s something for everyone!
 
 Quality is our priority! We farm and produce our own in-house tomato sauce from Italian Roma tomatoes in the northern part of Italy. The final product then goes through an intensive quality control process to assure quality in every bite of tomato pasta you take.

items.name: D-Black Pepper Chicken Pasta
items.description: Tender baked chicken slices are tossed with onions and capsicum in a rich black pepper brown sauce, delivering a savoury medley with a bold peppery kick.

items.name: D-Sambal Beef Aglio
items.description: A fiery aglio olio featuring tender beef short plate, capsicum and onions, elevated with crispy prawn chilli, fried baby shrimp and fragrant parsley for a satisfying blend of savoury, spicy and umami flavours.

items.name: D-Prawn Bisque Laksa Pasta
items.description: Succulent prawns, scallops and clams are tossed in a light laksa sauce enriched with prawn bisque, cherry tomatoes and onions, bringing together the comforting flavours of local laksa with the indulgence of pasta.
